entries.title: Isaiah 40:1
segments: ¶"Comfort, yes, comfort My people!" Says your God.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:2
segments: "Speak comfort to Jerusalem, and cry out to her, That her warfare is ended, That her iniquity is pardoned; For she has received from the LORD'S hand Double for all her sins."

entries.title: Isaiah 40:3
segments: ¶The voice of one crying in the wilderness: "Prepare the way of the LORD; Make straight in the desert A highway for our God.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:4
segments: Every valley shall be exalted And every mountain and hill brought low; The crooked places shall be made straight And the rough places smooth;

entries.title: Isaiah 40:5
segments: The glory of the LORD shall be revealed, And all flesh shall see [it] together; For the mouth of the LORD has spoken."

entries.title: Isaiah 40:6
segments: The voice said, "Cry out!" And he said, "What shall I cry?" "All flesh [is] grass, And all its loveliness [is] like the flower of the field.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:7
segments: The grass withers, the flower fades, Because the breath of the LORD blows upon it; Surely the people [are] grass.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:8
segments: The grass withers, the flower fades, But the word of our God stands forever."

entries.title: Isaiah 40:9
segments: ¶O Zion, You who bring good tidings, Get up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, You who bring good tidings, Lift up your voice with strength, Lift [it] up, be not afraid; Say to the cities of Judah, "Behold your God!"

entries.title: Isaiah 40:10
segments: Behold, the Lord GOD shall come with a strong [hand], And His arm shall rule for Him; Behold, His reward [is] with Him, And His work before Him.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:11
segments: He will feed His flock like a shepherd; He will gather the lambs with His arm, And carry [them] in His bosom, [And] gently lead those who are with young.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:12
segments: ¶Who has measured the waters in the hollow of His hand, Measured heaven with a span And calculated the dust of the earth in a measure? Weighed the mountains in scales And the hills in a balance?

entries.title: Isaiah 40:13
segments: Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD, Or [as] His counselor has taught Him?

entries.title: Isaiah 40:14
segments: With whom did He take counsel, and [who] instructed Him, And taught Him in the path of justice? Who taught Him knowledge, And showed Him the way of understanding?

entries.title: Isaiah 40:15
segments: Behold, the nations [are] as a drop in a bucket, And are counted as the small dust on the scales; Look, He lifts up the isles as a very little thing.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:16
segments: And Lebanon [is] not sufficient to burn, Nor its beasts sufficient for a burnt offering.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:17
segments: All nations before Him [are] as nothing, And they are counted by Him less than nothing and worthless.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:18
segments: ¶To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to Him?

entries.title: Isaiah 40:19
segments: The workman molds an image, The goldsmith overspreads it with gold, And the silversmith casts silver chains.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:20
segments: Whoever [is] too impoverished for [such] a contribution Chooses a tree [that] will not rot; He seeks for himself a skillful workman To prepare a carved image [that] will not totter.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:21
segments: Have you not known? Have you not heard? Has it not been told you from the beginning? Have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?

entries.title: Isaiah 40:22
segments: [It is] He who sits above the circle of the earth, And its inhabitants [are] like grasshoppers, Who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, And spreads them out like a tent to dwell in.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:23
segments: He brings the princes to nothing; He makes the judges of the earth useless.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:24
segments: Scarcely shall they be planted, Scarcely shall they be sown, Scarcely shall their stock take root in the earth, When He will also blow on them, And they will wither, And the whirlwind will take them away like stubble.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:25
segments: "To whom then will you liken Me, Or [to whom] shall I be equal?" says the Holy One.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:26
segments: Lift up your eyes on high, And see who has created these [things], Who brings out their host by number; He calls them all by name, By the greatness of His might And the strength of [His] power; Not one is missing.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:27
segments: ¶Why do you say, O Jacob, And speak, O Israel: "My way is hidden from the LORD, And my just claim is passed over by my God"?

entries.title: Isaiah 40:28
segments: Have you not known? Have you not heard? The everlasting God, the LORD, The Creator of the ends of the earth, Neither faints nor is weary. His understanding is unsearchable.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:29
segments: He gives power to the weak, And to [those who have] no might He increases strength.

entries.title: Isaiah 40:30
segments: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, And the young men shall utterly fall,

entries.title: Isaiah 40:31
segments: But those who wait on the LORD Shall renew [their] strength; They shall mount up with wings like eagles, They shall run and not be weary, They shall walk and not faint.
